parsed.degree_signal: Master’s, or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., machine learning, mathematics, statistics, computational sciences)
parsed.notes:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS defaults to required; PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS makes its items nice_to_have. The general invitation to apply without every qualification does not change these labels.
Degree fields are not independently treated as skill requirements. Other scientific domains are excluded as domain knowledge; cheminformatics is flagged because it is both explicitly named in the taxonomy and presented here as a domain.
AI infrastructure is flagged because it is named as the context for FinOps rather than as a standalone proficiency.
PyTorch or JAX/TensorFlow is read literally as alternative framework choices. The orchestration-framework examples form a second alternative group; the platform list joined by 'and' does not.
Technologies appearing only in the role description, responsibilities, or employer-benefits narrative, including MLOps, are excluded.
